content:
amelia: Kicking off v5.0.0 rollout to eu-west during the 02:30 UTC change window. Canary 5% at 02:35, planned ramp to 40% at 02:50. Watch p95, 5xx, 429-rate, and synthetic heartbeat. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/5.0.0 :sparkles;

ricardo: copy. I set traffic tag `v5-0-0-canary` and a rollback leash to `v4-4-0`. Also pre-created a route pin template in case we need per-route fallbacks.

deploy-bot: canary_start triggered by @amelia at 02:35 UTC. canary_id=canary-2026-12-31-02. 5% -> v5-0-0-canary. Monitoring hooks active.

slo-bot: ALERT: 429-rate-eu-west crossed threshold at 02:38 UTC (window=1m). 429_rate=1.8% (threshold=0.3%). Tagging thread.

jamal: seeing 429s spike tied to embedding QPS bursts from a single tenant test harness. Traces show rate-limiter token-bucket depletion on canary pods. The new per-instance limiter defaults changed in the runtime. Suspect config drift.

sree: running quick smoke for generation and embeddings. Generation paths are fine, embeddings report 429s with body: 
```json
{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after_ms":1200}
```

olivia: dashboards: p95 didn't budge but 429s cause elevated client retries and some upstream 5xxs at the ingress. We'll likely see a bursty error budget hit if this continues. Temporarily increasing sampling and enabling request traces for the canary pool.

amelia: hold the ramp. Decision criteria: if 429_rate > 0.5% over 3 consecutive windows OR any customer-facing 5xx spike, we rollback. Jamal, can you patch the limiter config to match prod-defaults and rewarm? If not quick, we rollback the canary to v4-4-0.

jamal: trying hotpatch now (canary-pool/rate_limiter=prod-default). Pushing via orchestrator.

deploy-bot: config_patch applied to canary pool at 02:42 UTC. patch_id=patch-rl-20261231-01. Reprobes running.

slo-bot: INFO: 429_rate trending down to 0.45% at 02:44 UTC. Monitoring windows still open.

olivia: heartbeat ok, but client retry queueing causing transient 5xx spikes at the gateway (0.15% -> 0.6%). If gateway 5xx crosses 0.5% we will need to pull back.

amelia: gateway 5xx at 02:46 is 0.55%. Triggering rollback decision now. Jamal, please execute rollback to `v4-4-0` for the canary and lift routing pins as needed. Mark the deployment paused and start comms.

jamal: initiating rollback. Command: 
```bash
POST /v1/deployments/rollback 
{ "canary_id": "canary-2026-12-31-02", "rollback_to": "v4-4-0" }
```

deploy-bot: rollback started at 02:47 UTC for canary_id=canary-2026-12-31-02. Traffic reverted to v4-4-0.

ricardo: applied emergency route-level pin for `embeddings:*` to v4-4-0 across eu-west while we stabilize. POST /v1/routing/pins {"routes":["embeddings:*"],"pin_to":"v4-4-0","scope":"eu-west"} -> success.

sree: post-rollback smoke: embeddings OK, 429_rate ~0.02%, gateway 5xx back to baseline. Latency p95 stable.

amaelia: good response. Next steps: open a short incident ticket, tag `root-cause: limiter-default`, and schedule a brief postmortem. Jamal, include the config diff and PR to align canary default with prod. Ricardo, add a line to the release notes about the rollout being paused due to rate limiter config drift.

jamal: creating PR to revert the unintended default and to add a canary-guard test for limiter behavior. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/4121. Incident ticket: INC-2026-324.

ricardo: updating release notes now. Marking this rollout `paused: true` and `reason: rate-limiter-default-drift`. Will re-run canary after the PR and a short canary-guard test.

amelia: schedule follow-up canary at 04:00 UTC earliest. If postmortem shows process gap, we'll add a preflight check to block canaries with non-prod limiter defaults. Thanks for the fast triage. If anyone sees customer reports, route them to #customer-success.

slo-bot: NOTE: SLO snapshot at 03:00 UTC will include the rollback window. Adding incident tag to the snapshot.

olivia: quick ask 	3: can we add a synthetic that exercises the limiter under burst to CI so future canaries catch this?

jamal: yes adding a canary-guard job to CI now. Will update the PR with test details.

amelia: thumbs to confirm closure of the rollback thread. React with :white_check_mark: if you'd like this archived.

olivia: :white_check_mark:

sree: :white_check_mark:

jamal: :white_check_mark:
